column8: ["Give the broad ochre housing richer ceramic character: pooled glaze, fine crazing and rubbed edges would make its softly mottled surface more tangible.","Differentiate the reddish seat collars with dark brass recesses, polished lips and worn rubber interiors; their similar soft shading currently blurs the materials together.","Sharpen selected rim highlights and contact shadows to give the openings firmer construction and the housing greater weight.","Develop the central fitting into a deliberate crafted detail; its muddy concentric rings currently look less resolved than the surrounding seats."]

["Give the broad ochre surface more crafted detail: pooled glaze, fine crazing and rubbed patches would make its large uninterrupted areas reward inspection.","Separate the materials more clearly; the coppery collars and golden body share a soft, mottled finish. Sharper brass glints and matte rubber lips would add tangible contrast.","Vary the repeated collars with deliberate wear and a few distinctive fittings so the housing feels individually built rather than stamped from one painted motif."]
